items.imgPrompt: Dark red velvet cloak with gold embroidery, draped over a velvet chair, slight tear and faint water stain on the hem, dimly lit opulent bedroom setting.

name.zh: 边缘破损的暗红天鹅绒御氅
name.zh_cn: 边缘破损的暗红天鹅绒御氅
name.en: Torn Dark Red Velvet Imperial Cloak

desc.zh: 邊緣有些許撕裂和水漬。別問是怎麼弄壞的，敢妄議朕的寢宮私事，誅你九族！買走，別讓朕再看到它想起那天晚上的失態……咳，朕是說這布料太差了。
desc.zh_cn: 边缘有些许撕裂和水渍。别问是怎么弄坏的，敢妄议朕的寝宫私事，诛你九族！买走，别让朕再看到它想起那天晚上的失态……咳，朕是说这布料太差了。
desc.en: Slight tears and water stains on the edge. Don't ask how it got ruined. Dare to gossip about my private chambers and I'll execute your entire family! Buy it, don't let me see it and remember my loss of control that night... Ahem, I mean the fabric is just inferior.

items.imgPrompt: Rectangular pillow made of white jade blocks and pale blue silk, resting on a dark wooden bedstand, slightly used, cool lighting.

name.zh: 冰絲玉石安神枕
name.zh_cn: 冰丝玉石安神枕

desc.zh: 以前用來壓抑……頭痛和燥熱的。現在不需要了，反正朕有了別的“梳理”方式。拿走，這東西冷冰冰的，朕現在受不了任何多餘的冰冷觸碰。
desc.zh_cn: 以前用来压抑……头痛和燥热的。现在不需要了，反正朕有了别的“梳理”方式。拿走，这东西冷冰冰的，朕现在受不了任何多余的冰冷触碰。
desc.en: Used to suppress... headaches and heat. I don't need it anymore, I have another way of 'soothing' now anyway. Take it away, it's freezing, I can't stand any extra cold touches right now.

items.imgPrompt: Ornate solid gold letter opener encrusted with small diamonds, resting on a dark mahogany desk, slight fingerprints on the blade, luxurious office setting.

name.zh: 鑲鑽純金拆信刀
name.zh_cn: 镶钻纯金拆信刀

desc.zh: 某個貪婪公爵送來的貢品，俗不可耐。朕只用來裁過一次那本《位面導航名錄》的封套。太重了，拿著手酸，不配放在朕的專屬書齋。
desc.zh_cn: 某个贪婪公爵送来的贡品，俗不可耐。朕只用来裁过一次那本《位面导航名录》的封套。太重了，拿着手酸，不配放在朕的专属书斋。
desc.en: Tribute from some greedy duke. Incredibly tacky. I only used it once to open the envelope for that 'Dimensional Navigation Directory'. It's too heavy, makes my hand sore, and doesn't deserve a place in my private study.

items.imgPrompt: Heavy glass paperweight shaped like a coiled snake with emerald green eyes, sitting on a stack of old parchment, slightly dusty, soft library lighting.

name.zh: 綠寶石靈蛇鎮紙
name.zh_cn: 绿宝石灵蛇镇纸

desc.zh: 那個荒謬的分院帽測試說朕是斯萊特林後，底下人自作主張送來的。醜死了，眼睛的顏色讓朕心煩。趕緊買走，不然朕就把這玩意扔進地牢！
desc.zh_cn: 那个荒谬的分院帽测试说朕是斯莱特林后，底下人自作主张送来的。丑死了，眼睛的颜色让朕心烦。赶紧买走，不然朕就把这玩意扔进地牢！
desc.en: Sent by subordinates after that ridiculous Sorting Hat test said I was Slytherin. Hideous. The color of its eyes annoys me. Buy it quickly before I throw this thing into the dungeon!

items.imgPrompt: Thick antique book with a worn leather cover and faded gold runic lettering, slightly frayed pages, resting on a stone table, dimly lit castle setting.

name.zh: 龍族弱點解析古籍
name.zh_cn: 龙族弱点解析古籍

desc.zh: 滿篇廢話。對付德拉科爾那種大白天發情的蠢貨根本用不上這書，直接禁言比什麼都快。佔地方，別讓它髒了朕的專屬書房。
desc.zh_cn: 满篇废话。对付德拉科尔那种大白天发情的蠢货根本用不上这书，直接禁言比什么都快。占地方，别让它脏了朕的专属书房。
desc.en: Full of nonsense. Completely useless against a daytime-in-heat idiot like Draco; muting him is faster than anything else. Taking up space, don't let it dirty my private study.

items.imgPrompt: A delicate black silk mourning veil with intricate lace edges, resting on a dark velvet cushion, soft melancholic lighting, slightly wrinkled.

name.zh: 黑色真絲喪服面紗
name.zh_cn: 黑色真丝丧服面纱

desc.zh: 為一位心碎而亡的未亡人縫製的，她沒來得及戴上。承載了太多悲傷，或許有人能用它來演一齣戲劇。
desc.zh_cn: 为一位心碎而亡的未亡人缝制的，她没来得及戴上。承载了太多悲伤，或许有人能用它来演一出戏剧。
desc.en: I sewed this for a widow who died of a broken heart before she could wear it. It carries too much sorrow, perhaps someone can use it for a play.

items.imgPrompt: A wooden spool partially wrapped with shimmering silver thread, sitting on a worn wooden sewing table next to a pair of antique scissors.

name.zh: 縫製壽衣的銀線
name.zh_cn: 缝制寿衣的银线

desc.zh: 為一個年輕靈魂裁製喪服時多買的。這銀色對我的眼睛來說太刺眼了……如果你想修補些什麼，就拿去吧。
desc.zh_cn: 为一个年轻灵魂裁制丧服时多买的。这银色对我的眼睛来说太刺眼了……如果你想修补些什么，就拿去吧。
desc.en: Bought extra when tailoring a shroud for a young soul. The silver is too bright for my eyes now... take it if you wish to mend something.

items.imgPrompt: A flattened, dried white rose pressed into a clear resin bookmark with faded golden tassels, resting on an open old book on a wooden desk.

name.zh: 枯萎的白玫瑰書籤
name.zh_cn: 枯萎的白玫瑰书签

desc.zh: 夾在我們一起讀過的那本悼亡詩選裡。花瓣已經脆了，就像生命一樣，但悲傷的餘香還在。
desc.zh_cn: 夹在我们一起读过的那本悼亡诗选里。花瓣已经脆了，就像生命一样，但悲伤的余香还在。
desc.en: It was pressed between the pages of the elegies we read together. The petals are brittle, just like life, but the lingering scent of sorrow remains.

items.imgPrompt: A small vintage glass apothecary vial containing dark amber resin tears, dusty exterior with a tarnished cork, sitting on a dimly lit stone windowsill.

name.zh: 裝有安息香的舊玻璃瓶
name.zh_cn: 装有安息香的旧玻璃瓶

desc.zh: 我曾以為這種香料能讓徘徊的亡魂安息……但我失敗了。我仍在尋找真正的配方，不過瓶子還是很美的。
desc.zh_cn: 我曾以为这种香料能让徘徊的亡魂安息……但我失败了。我仍在寻找真正的配方，不过瓶子还是很美的。
desc.en: I thought this incense would help wandering spirits find peace... but I failed. I am still searching for the true recipe, though the vial is beautiful.

items.imgPrompt: A long, semi-transparent black feather fashioned into a calligraphy quill pen, resting on a piece of blank parchment on a dark wooden table.

name.zh: 黑色半透明羽毛筆
name.zh_cn: 黑色半透明羽毛笔

desc.zh: 在一個異常安靜的夜晚，我掉落的一根羽毛。本想用它來寫訃告，但總會讓字跡沾滿眼淚。
desc.zh_cn: 在一个异常安静的夜晚，我掉落的一根羽毛。本想用它来写讣告，但总会让字迹沾满眼泪。
desc.en: A feather of mine that fell on an unusually quiet night. I meant to use it to write obituaries, but it always makes the handwriting stained with tears.

items.imgPrompt: A half-empty plastic bottle of industrial thick lubricant, slightly greasy exterior, sitting on a dark wooden table next to a rag, dimly lit room.

name.zh: 工業級管道潤滑脂
name.zh_cn: 工业级管道润滑脂

desc.zh: 哎呀，買多了。說實話，以我這柔軟無骨的身段根本用不上，不過偶爾在狹窄的地方稍微“卡住”一下……也挺有情趣的不是嗎？
desc.zh_cn: 哎呀，买多了。说实话，以我这柔软无骨的身段根本用不上，不过偶尔在狭窄的地方稍微“卡住”一下……也挺有情趣的不是吗？
desc.en: Oops, bought too much. Honestly, with my boneless flexibility I don't even need it, but sometimes getting slightly 'stuck' in a tight space... has its own charm, doesn't it?

items.imgPrompt: A pure gold ornate goblet with visible deep scratches and dents on one side, resting on a velvet cloth on a messy desk, dramatic lighting.

name.zh: 帶有劃痕的貴族金杯
name.zh_cn: 带有划痕的贵族金杯

desc.zh: 從東區金庫順出來的。就是在論壇跟你抱怨過的那個帶倒刺的排氣管，害我把杯子磕出了劃痕！純金的，親愛的你要是喜歡就便宜拿去~
desc.zh_cn: 从东区金库顺出来的。就是在论坛跟你抱怨过的那个带倒刺的排气管，害我把杯子磕出了划痕！纯金的，亲爱的你要是喜欢就便宜拿去~
desc.en: Snatched from the East District vault. Scratched it on that barbed exhaust pipe I complained to you about on the forum! It's pure gold, darling, take it cheap if you like it~

items.imgPrompt: A shiny black rubber bodysuit, slightly wrinkled, laid flat on an unmade bed, tags removed but looks pristine, natural indoor lighting.

name.zh: 尺碼偏大的緊身膠皮衣
name.zh_cn: 尺码偏大的紧身胶皮衣

desc.zh: 尺碼買錯了，根本不能緊緊勒住我的身體！身為大盜，穿這種毫無壓迫感的衣服怎麼能享受潛入的快感？僅試穿，便宜出了。
desc.zh_cn: 尺码买错了，根本不能紧紧勒住我的身体！身为大盗，穿这种毫无压迫感的衣服怎么能享受潜入的快感？仅试穿，便宜出了。
desc.en: Bought the wrong size, it doesn't squeeze my body tightly at all! As a master thief, how can I enjoy the thrill of infiltration in a suit with no pressure? Only tried on, selling cheap.

items.imgPrompt: A crumpled piece of aged parchment with faded hand-drawn maps and water stains, pinned to a corkboard in a shadowy room, corner slightly torn.

name.zh: 皇宮地下水路草圖
name.zh_cn: 皇宫地下水路草图

desc.zh: 我早就背得滾瓜爛熟了。親愛的，你不是對皇宮裡的東西感興趣嗎？買下它，說不定我還會附贈你一個關於皇帝酒窖的小秘密哦。
desc.zh_cn: 我早就背得滚瓜烂熟了。亲爱的，你不是对皇宫里的东西感兴趣吗？买下它，说不定我还会附赠你一个关于皇帝酒窖的小秘密哦。
desc.en: I've memorized it back to front already. Darling, aren't you interested in things from the palace? Buy this, and I might just throw in a little secret about the Emperor's wine cellar.

items.imgPrompt: A pair of heavy red hydraulic bolt cutters, chipped paint on the handles, lying on a cold stone floor next to some scattered screws.

name.zh: 笨重的液壓剪
name.zh_cn: 笨重的液压剪

desc.zh: 太重了！能靠縮骨功鑽過去的縫隙，我才懶得費力氣剪開。占地方，給那個買機械潤滑油的艾薩克用還差不多，親愛的你要是能幫我轉交就更好了。
desc.zh_cn: 太重了！能靠缩骨功钻过去的缝隙，我才懒得费力气剪开。占地方，给那个买机械润滑油的艾萨克用还差不多，亲爱的你要是能帮我转交就更好了。
desc.en: Too heavy! Why bother cutting open a gap when I can just dislocate my bones and squeeze through? Takes up space, might be good for that Isaac guy who buys mechanical lube. Darling, it'd be even better if you could pass it to him for me.

items.imgPrompt: A high-end blue enamel cast iron soup pot, visibly dented and squeezed on one side, sitting on a modern kitchen counter, natural lighting, showing signs of heavy force damage.

name.zh: 稍微變形的琺瑯湯鍋
name.zh_cn: 稍微变形的珐琅汤锅

desc.zh: 凡人的器具實在太過脆弱。吾在這逼仄的廚房為汝熬煮羹湯時，翼爪不過輕輕一握，它便凹陷了。吾已為汝換了更堅固的鼎，這廢品隨便處置了吧。
desc.zh_cn: 凡人的器具实在太过脆弱。吾在这逼仄的厨房为汝熬煮羹汤时，翼爪不过轻轻一握，它便凹陷了。吾已为汝换了更坚固的鼎，这废品随便处置了吧。
desc.en: Mortal vessels are far too fragile. While cooking broth for you in this cramped kitchen, my wing-claws merely gripped it lightly, and it caved in. I have replaced it with a sturdier cauldron for you; dispose of this trash as you see fit.

items.imgPrompt: Black premium over-ear noise-canceling headphones, resting on a dark wooden desk near a laptop, flawless condition, soft indoor lighting, 99% new.

name.zh: 頂配降噪耳機
name.zh_cn: 顶配降噪耳机

desc.zh: 愚蠢的造物。吾本想用它隔絕群裡那些野獸（尤其是那隻叫囂著要咬人的瘋狗）的聒噪，卻忘了吾之聽覺乃靈魂與骨骼的共振。塞住耳朵毫無意義。全新，僅試戴。
desc.zh_cn: 愚蠢的造物。吾本想用它隔绝群里那些野兽（尤其是那只叫嚣着要咬人的疯狗）的聒噪，却忘了吾之听觉乃灵魂与骨骼的共振。塞住耳朵毫无意义。全新，仅试戴。
desc.en: A foolish invention. I intended to use this to block out the incessant noise of those beasts in the group (especially that mad dog clamoring to bite people), forgetting my hearing is the resonance of soul and bone. Plugging ears is pointless. Brand new, only tried on once.

items.imgPrompt: A massive, glowing purple amethyst geode with some grey rock matrix attached, sitting on a living room carpet, highly detailed, slightly dusty.

name.zh: 含有雜質的地脈原石
name.zh_cn: 含有杂质的地脉原石

desc.zh: 吾從地脈深處隨手挖出的石頭。原本想用來裝飾囚…裝飾汝的蓮花神座，但仔細看雜質太多了。換些凡人的貨幣，權當給汝買伊茲奇所說的甜果的零花錢。
desc.zh_cn: 吾从地脉深处随手挖出的石头。原本想用来装饰囚…装饰汝的莲花神座，但仔细看杂质太多了。换些凡人的货币，权当给汝买伊兹奇所说的甜果的零花钱。
desc.en: A stone I casually dug out from the depths of the ley lines. I originally wanted to use it to decorate the lotus shrine where I will impri... seat you, but it has too many impurities. Exchange it for mortal currency as your pocket money to buy the sweet fruits Izuchi mentioned.

items.imgPrompt: A luxurious black silk sleep mask, slightly wrinkled, laid on a white bedsheet, soft natural bedroom lighting, 90% condition.

name.zh: 真絲遮光眼罩
name.zh_cn: 真丝遮光眼罩

desc.zh: 泡狐龍（御津根）極力推薦的凡人安眠之物。可笑，這薄如蟬翼的布料如何能遮蔽吾額上的慈眼？吾若睜眼，這破布瞬間便會化為灰燼。
desc.zh_cn: 泡狐龙（御津根）极力推荐的凡人安眠之物。可笑，这薄如蝉翼的布料如何能遮蔽吾额上的慈眼？吾若睁眼，这破布瞬间便会化为灰烬。
desc.en: A mortal sleep aid highly recommended by Mizutsune. Ridiculous. How could this flimsy fabric conceal the benevolent eye on my forehead? If I open my eyes, this rag would instantly turn to ashes.

items.imgPrompt: A red handheld motorized rotary tiller, slightly dirty with dry soil on the metal blades, leaning against a balcony wall, outdoor daytime lighting, 90% condition.

name.zh: 小型手持旋耕機
name.zh_cn: 小型手持旋耕机

desc.zh: 汝說想在陽台種些花草，吾便買了這凡人的農具。但吾只需一念便能翻覆整片平原，這破銅爛鐵實在效率低下，又佔用吾等狹小的居所。拿走。
desc.zh_cn: 汝说想在阳台种些花草，吾便买了这凡人的农具。但吾只需一念便能翻覆整片平原，这破铜烂铁实在效率低下，又占用吾等狭小的居所。拿走。
desc.en: You said you wanted to plant some flowers on the balcony, so I bought this mortal farming tool. But I can overturn an entire plain with a single thought. This scrap metal is woefully inefficient and takes up space in our cramped dwelling. Take it away.

items.imgPrompt: A dusty glass bottle filled with amber liquid, sitting on a dark wooden military desk, dimly lit, cold atmosphere, no labels.

name.zh: 沒收的劣質烈酒
name.zh_cn: 没收的劣质烈酒

desc.zh: 部下在巡邏時偷藏的蠢東西。我只喝高熱量的頂級伏特加，這種雜質太多的液體只會弄髒我的營帳。拿去暖身吧。
desc.zh_cn: 部下在巡逻时偷藏的蠢东西。我只喝高热量的顶级伏特加，这种杂质太多的液体只会弄脏我的营帐。拿去暖身吧。
desc.en: Stupid contraband confiscated from a patrolling subordinate. I only drink top-tier high-calorie vodka; this impure liquid just pollutes my tent. Take it to warm yourself up.

items.imgPrompt: A small glass vial filled with glowing pale blue powder, resting on a metallic tray, frosty background, macro photography.

name.zh: 高純度催眠粉塵（試劑瓶裝）
name.zh_cn: 高纯度催眠粉尘（试剂瓶装）

desc.zh: 提煉時多出來的殘次品。只要一小撮就能讓大型獵物陷入昏睡……如果你失眠的話也可以用，但我更建議你直接來找我。
desc.zh_cn: 提炼时多出来的残次品。只要一小撮就能让大型猎物陷入昏睡……如果你失眠的话也可以用，但我更建议你直接来找我。
desc.en: Excess product from my extraction process. A tiny pinch will put large prey into a deep slumber... You can use it if you have insomnia, though I'd highly recommend you just come to me instead.

items.imgPrompt: A brightly colored exotic fruit, completely encased in a thick block of clear ice, sitting on a snowy windowsill.

name.zh: 某隻龍送的甜果（已凍硬）
name.zh_cn: 某只龙送的甜果（已冻硬）
name.en: Sweet Fruit from Some Dragon (Frozen Solid)

desc.zh: 伊茲奇那個蠢貨非要塞給我的，說什麼是你喜歡的口味。在我的防區不到十分鐘就凍成了石頭，想要就拿走，別說我吃醋。
desc.zh_cn: 伊兹奇那个蠢货非要塞给我的，说什么是你喜欢的口味。在我的防区不到十分钟就冻成了石头，想要就拿走，别说我吃醋。
desc.en: That idiot Izuchi forced this on me, claiming it's your favorite flavor. It froze solid like a rock within ten minutes in my sector. Take it if you want, and don't you dare say I'm jealous.

items.imgPrompt: A rolled-up worn parchment map with blue ink tactical markings, edges slightly frayed, lying on a dark fur rug.

name.zh: 過期的冰原貨運路線圖
name.zh_cn: 过期的冰原货运路线图

desc.zh: 上次風雪把舊商道全衝散了，這張廢紙已經沒有戰術價值。不過上面有我親手做的標記，或許有些無聊的人會想收藏。
desc.zh_cn: 上次风雪把旧商道全冲散了，这张废纸已经没有战术价值。不过上面有我亲手做的标记，或许有些无聊的人会想收藏。
desc.en: The recent blizzard completely wiped out the old trade routes, rendering this scrap paper tactically useless. It does have my handwritten notes on it, though, in case some bored person wants to collect it.

items.imgPrompt: A pristine, fluffy white and pale blue fur scarf, neatly folded on a dark leather chair, soft natural indoor lighting.

name.zh: 過於柔軟的獸毛圍脖
name.zh_cn: 过于柔软的兽毛围脖

desc.zh: 原本是買來……咳，作為軍需品採購的，但這種軟綿綿的東西根本不適合戰場。你的脖子要是怕冷就買去，別凍死了。
desc.zh_cn: 原本是买来……咳，作为军需品采购的，但这种软绵绵的东西根本不适合战场。你的脖子要是怕冷就买去，别冻死了。
desc.en: Originally bought for... ahem, procured as military supplies, but this soft, fluffy thing is completely unsuited for the battlefield. Buy it if your neck gets cold, don't freeze to death.

items.imgPrompt: A thick magic theory book resting on a wooden desk, the bottom right corner of the cover is visibly scorched and curled, illuminated by dim candlelight.

name.zh: 《埃爾溫第三定律解析》附筆記
name.zh_cn: 《埃尔温第三定律解析》附笔记
name.en: "Analysis of Erwin's Third Law" with Notes

desc.zh: 對、對不起，書角被我昨天炸膛時不小心燎到了一點...但是裡面的力學推演筆記我都寫得很全的！求求好心人買走吧，我還需要賠公會的柱子錢嗚嗚...
desc.zh_cn: 对、对不起，书角被我昨天炸膛时不小心燎到了一点...但是里面的力学推演笔记我都写得很全的！求求好心人买走吧，我还需要赔公会的柱子钱呜呜...
desc.en: S-sorry, the corner of the book got a little scorched when I backfired yesterday... but my mechanics deduction notes inside are very complete! Please, someone buy this, I still need to pay for the guild's pillar wu wu...

items.imgPrompt: A simple wooden wand lying on a worn cloth, the tip is blackened and splintered from heat damage, placed on a rustic wooden table.

name.zh: 新手木製練習法杖（微焦）
name.zh_cn: 新手木制练习法杖（微焦）

desc.zh: 理論上它能疏導指尖亂竄的魔力，但、但是我一緊張它就發燙，前端已經有點焦糊了...我真的太沒用了，連新手杖都用不好，便宜賣了...
desc.zh_cn: 理论上它能疏导指尖乱窜的魔力，但、但是我一紧张它就发烫，前端已经有点焦糊了...我真的太没用了，连新手杖都用不好，便宜卖了...
desc.en: In theory, it can channel the erratic magic in my fingertips, b-but it gets hot whenever I get nervous, and the tip is already slightly charred... I'm really too useless, I can't even use a beginner wand properly, selling it cheap...

items.imgPrompt: Three pristine rolls of thick parchment tied with a simple string, sitting untouched on a cluttered, slightly soot-stained wooden desk.

name.zh: 全新防爆防水羊皮紙卷
name.zh_cn: 全新防爆防水羊皮纸卷

desc.zh: 上次打翻墨水後買的，可是我根本不敢再去自習室推演了...您之前在消息裡說要把我買回家是真的嗎？啊不對，請、請看看羊皮紙！
desc.zh_cn: 上次打翻墨水后买的，可是我根本不敢再去自习室推演了...您之前在消息里说要把我买回家是真的吗？啊不对，请、请看看羊皮纸！
desc.en: I bought these after spilling ink last time, but I don't dare go to the study room to do deductions anymore... Was it true when you said in the messages that you'd buy me back? Ah no, p-please look at the parchment!

items.imgPrompt: A cheap iron chest plate with a distinct inward dent and scorch marks in the center, resting on a patched grey blanket.

name.zh: 鐵級冒險者護心鏡
name.zh_cn: 铁级冒险者护心镜

desc.zh: 接低級任務時為了保命買的，結果還沒遇到魔物，就被我自己放的火球術反噬炸凹了一塊...對不起我知道品相很差，隨便給點錢就行！
desc.zh_cn: 接低级任务时为了保命买的，结果还没遇到魔物，就被我自己放的火球术反噬炸凹了一块...对不起我知道品相很差，随便给点钱就行！
desc.en: I bought this to save my life on low-level quests, but before I even met a monster, it got dented by the backlash of my own fireball... I'm sorry, I know the condition is terrible, just pay whatever you want!

items.imgPrompt: A small, plain clay jar filled halfway with a dull yellowish ointment, sitting on a wooden windowsill next to a small dried herb.

name.zh: 剩半罐的低級燒傷藥
name.zh_cn: 剩半罐的低级烧伤药

desc.zh: 因為您和阿瑞奧斯先生給了我更好的清涼草藥膏，這個就用不上了...我想努力攢錢，哪怕一次也好，想請您吃個麵包...求您別嫌棄！
desc.zh_cn: 因为您和阿瑞奥斯先生给了我更好的清凉草药膏，这个就用不上了...我想努力攒钱，哪怕一次也好，想请您吃个面包...求您别嫌弃！
desc.en: Because you and Mr. Areos gave me a better cooling herbal ointment, I don't need this one anymore... I want to try hard to save money, even if it's just once, to buy you a piece of bread... Please don't despise it!

items.imgPrompt: heavy duty stainless steel revolving bearing mount, industrial metal turntable base, faint lubricant stains, resting on a scarred wooden workbench

name.zh: 強化旋轉底座模組（未組裝）
name.zh_cn: 强化旋转底座模组（未组装）

desc.zh: 原本打算替捕獲的球狀蛛化生物製作360度離心觀察台。親愛的高級指示說暫時不需要轉動他，因此多出。
desc.zh_cn: 原本打算替捕获的球状蛛化生物制作360度离心观察台。亲爱的高级指示说暂时不需要转动他，因此多出。
desc.en: Originally intended to build a 360-degree centrifugal display for that spherical drider. Darling said spinning him wasn't necessary, so it is surplus.

items.imgPrompt: assorted grey ceramic grinding blocks and worn polishing pads, silver metal dust traces, neatly lined up on a dark slate surface

name.zh: 工業金屬研磨砂塊與粗拋光片組
name.zh_cn: 工业金属研磨砂块与粗抛光片组
name.en: Industrial Metal Grinding & Rough Polishing Set

desc.zh: 舊的打磨耗材。質地太硬，親愛的手指碰上會痛。我已全數更換為親膚的羊毛拋光輪，以便擁抱。
desc.zh_cn: 旧的打磨耗材。质地太硬，亲爱的碰触时会觉得糙。我已全数更换为亲肤羊毛抛光轮，以便拥抱。
desc.en: Old prosthetic buffing supplies. Too abrasive; Darling's skin might get scratched. Switched completely to soft wool wheels for embraces.

items.imgPrompt: charcoal grey hooded tactical cloak, dark heavy canvas, torn silver breast latch, folded neatly on a wooden stool, dim room lighting

name.zh: 防暗視戰術披風（胸口卡榫受損）
name.zh_cn: 防暗视战术披风（胸口卡榫受损）

desc.zh: 幽暗地域狩獵時，為露出水晶心臟充當誘餌而扯壞了暗扣。布料完好，親愛的手工法術殘留氣味已自然消散。
desc.zh_cn: 幽暗地域狩猎时，为露出水晶心脏充当诱饵而扯坏了暗扣。布料完好，亲爱的手工法术残留气味已自然消散。
desc.en: Clasp torn off while exposing my crystal heart as bait during our underdark hunt. Cloth intact; Darling's spell fragrance has faded.

items.imgPrompt: vintage brass oiler can with a long thin nozzle, minor scuffs, faint golden oil residue near spout, placed on workshop cloth

name.zh: 細嘴銅製潤滑油注油壺（附剩餘油料）
name.zh_cn: 细嘴铜制润滑油注油壶（附剩余油料）

desc.zh: 標準工業機油，氣味刺鼻。親愛的手工注入後背齒輪時皺了眉頭。我已經換成群裡訂購的無味特調油。
desc.zh_cn: 标准工业机油，气味刺鼻。亲爱的手工注入后背齿轮时皱了眉头。我已经换成群里订购的无味特调油。
desc.en: Standard mechanical oil, pungent smell. Darling frowned while helping lubricate my back gears with it. Replaced with odorless blend.

items.imgPrompt: disassembled antique brass music box cylinder, missing three gear teeth, tarnished metal, resting on a faded velvet cloth

name.zh: 缺齒發條八音盒滾筒機芯
name.zh_cn: 缺齿发条八音盒滚筒机芯

desc.zh: 旋律短缺了三道音階。我聽了七百次，胸口水晶未產生情感波長共振，證實這並非我失去的記憶殘片。
desc.zh_cn: 旋律短缺了三道音阶。我听了七百次，胸口水晶未产生情感波长共振，证实这并非我失去的记忆残片。
desc.en: Missing three notes. Played 700 times; no resonance triggered in my crystal heart. Confirmed not a piece of my lost memory.

items.imgPrompt: handwoven crimson and gold cashmere rug, intricate floral damask pattern, rolled on parquet floor, faint dark water stains near hem, soft natural light

name.zh: 西域重工刺繡加厚羊絨地毯
name.zh_cn: 西域重工刺绣加厚羊绒地毯

desc.zh: 只是不小心沾上了一點高溫精油與藥水，已經命人妥善洗淨。換了全新的所以這塊閒置。觸感極軟，某人以前踩在上面時說過喜歡。
desc.zh_cn: 只是不小心沾上了一点高温精油与药水，已经命人妥善洗净。换了全新的所以这块闲置。触感极软，某人以前踩在上面时说过喜欢。
desc.en: Accidentally got splashed with high-temp essential oils and potion, professionally cleaned. Very plush. Someone once mentioned liking the feel of it underfoot.

items.imgPrompt: vintage frosted glass jar with gilded brass lid, pale ivory grooming balm inside, slight scoop mark, sitting on dark mahogany dresser

name.zh: 龍角保養白檀冷凝角油
name.zh_cn: 龙角保养白檀冷凝角油

desc.zh: 以前用來保養額角符文的高階香膏，只取用過一次。現在某人願意親手替我揉角，我自然不需要這種冰涼的外物了。
desc.zh_cn: 以前用来保养额角符文的高阶香膏，只取用过一次。现在某人愿意亲手替我揉角，我自然不需要这种冰凉的外物了。
desc.en: A rare cooling salve previously used to care for forehead horn runes, used only once. Someone massages my horns personally now, so this is no longer needed.

items.imgPrompt: antique solid gold goblet, set with fiery orange opals, slight heat warping near stem base, resting on black velvet cloth, warm lighting

name.zh: 純金嵌火歐泊復古高腳酒杯
name.zh_cn: 纯金嵌火欧泊复古高脚酒杯
name.en: Gold Chalice Inlaid with Fire Opal

desc.zh: 龍族舊庫房清理出來的藏品。杯柄處有被過熱體溫微軟化的痕跡，不影響飲用。看膩了，騰出空間擺放某人送來的藥瓶。
desc.zh_cn: 龙族旧库房清理出来的藏品。杯柄处有被过热体温微软化的痕迹，不影响饮用。看腻了，腾出空间摆放某人送来的药瓶。
desc.en: Retrieved from my dragon hoard. The stem has minor softening from extreme body heat, perfectly usable. Making shelf room for potion vials.

items.imgPrompt: deep scarlet silk lounging robe, gold thread embroidery, spread on leather armchair, tailored back split, loosened waist tie, gentle fabric creases

name.zh: 熔岩絲綢暗紋開衩寢袍
name.zh_cn: 熔岩丝绸暗纹开衩寝袍

desc.zh: 特殊剪裁的絲綢袍子，背後留有尾骨舒展的縫隙。腰帶被觸手拉扯得稍有些鬆散，面料完好。穿著它並不保暖，但很方便某人隨時碰我。
desc.zh_cn: 特殊剪裁的丝绸袍子，背后留有尾骨舒展的缝隙。腰带被触手拉扯得稍有些松散，面料完好。穿着它并不保暖，但很方便某人随时碰我。
desc.en: Custom silk robe tailored with a slit for the tail. The sash is slightly stretched from tentacle tugging. Not particularly warm, but convenient.

items.imgPrompt: single iridescent crimson dragon scale, curved triangular shape, glowing gold veins, resting on a rustic wooden workshop table, dust specks

name.zh: 純血赤龍自然脫落護身逆鱗
name.zh_cn: 纯血赤龙自然脱落护身逆鳞
name.en: Naturally Shed Pure Red Dragon Scale

desc.zh: 上個月頸後自然脫落的護身鱗，蘊含純淨火元素。我已經將最好看的那幾枚親手交給專屬藥劑師了，這片多餘的就讓給識貨之人。
desc.zh_cn: 上个月颈后自然脱落的护身鳞，蕴含纯净火元素。我已经将最好看的那几枚亲手交给专属药剂师了，这片多余的就让给识货之人。
desc.en: Naturally shed from the nape last month, radiating pure fire element. I gave the prettiest scales to my pharmacist; passing this extra one to a true connoisseur.

items.imgPrompt: antique round bronze buckler mirror, scratched metal surface, faint tarnishing along edges, lying on cold damp cobblestone cellar floor, dim candlelight reflection

name.zh: 「防石化」拋光青銅小圓盾
name.zh_cn: 「防石化」抛光青铜小圆盾

desc.zh: 某個自以為是的入侵者舉著它衝進來，以為能反射凝視。真可笑。盾面稍微擦傷，別問原主人去哪了，問就是地窖門口的石雕。
desc.zh_cn: 某个自以为是的入侵者举着它冲进来，以为能反射凝视。真可笑。盾面稍微擦伤，别问原主人去哪了，问就是地窖门口的石雕。
desc.en: Some fool barged in holding this, thinking it'd reflect my gaze. Hilarious. Slight scuffs on the bronze. Don't ask about the owner—he's a lawn statue now.

items.imgPrompt: vintage brass tinted spectacles, dark smoked obsidian glass lenses, brass filigree frames, resting on dark red velvet inside a carved open wooden jewelry box

name.zh: 曜石深色遮光護目鏡
name.zh_cn: 曜石深色遮光护目镜

desc.zh: 訂製品。本來想著戴上它就能和普通人說話而不石化對方……幾乎全新。畢竟根本沒有人敢踏進地下室找我聊天。
desc.zh_cn: 订制品。本来想着戴上它就能和普通人说话而不石化对方……几乎全新。毕竟根本没有人敢踏进地下室找我聊天。
desc.en: Custom-made. Thought wearing this would let me talk without petrifying people... 99% new. Nobody ever dares come down to chat anyway.

items.imgPrompt: heavy duty black reptile heating mat, coiled cable, waterproof textured surface with light claw scratches, resting flat on an aged stone pedestal

name.zh: 特大號爬寵防水發熱墊（可調溫）
name.zh_cn: 特大号爬宠防水发热垫（可调温）

desc.zh: 這破陰濕天氣凍得蛇身骨節發僵，買來墊尾巴的。功能完好，就是表面黑漆漆的不反光，堆在金幣堆裡很難看，便宜出了。
desc.zh_cn: 这破阴湿天气冻得蛇身骨节发僵，买来垫尾巴的。功能完好，就是表面黑漆漆的不反光，堆在金币堆里很难看，便宜出了。
desc.en: Bought it to warm my tail in this damp, freezing crypt. Works fine, but the matte black looks ugly among my shiny gold coins. Take it.

items.imgPrompt: ornate vintage gilded brass chalice, baroque relief patterns, slight indentation on side base, resting on dark damp slate flagstone, soft warm light

name.zh: 重工鍍金雙耳雕花高足杯
name.zh_cn: 重工镀金双耳雕花高足杯

desc.zh: 光澤極佳。睡覺時尾巴不小心纏得太緊，底座邊緣壓出了一點微痕。它不是純金的，我不留雜質，識貨的拿走。
desc.zh_cn: 光泽极佳。睡觉时尾巴不小心缠得太紧，底座边缘压出了一点微痕。它不是纯金的，我不留杂质，识货的拿走。
desc.en: Gleams beautifully. Got a slight dent near the base when my tail coiled too tight in my sleep. Selling because it's brass-plated, not pure gold.

items.imgPrompt: stack of three sealed blue moisture absorber containers, white breathable paper tops, dusty plastic edges, placed in a shadowed stone dungeon corner

name.zh: 強力吸濕除濕盒（全新未拆封3盒）
name.zh_cn: 强力吸湿除湿盒（全新未拆封3盒）

desc.zh: 河口起霧連地下金庫都返潮，買多了三盒。趕緊拿走，水汽要是敢讓我的藏品生鏽，我會直接生氣。
desc.zh_cn: 河口起雾连地下金库都返潮，买多了三盒。赶紧拿走，水汽要是敢让我的藏品生锈，我会直接生气。
desc.en: River fog seeped all the way down into the vault. Three sealed boxes left. Take them before the dampness dares rust my treasures.

items.imgPrompt: three small hand-carved wooden animals, smooth light linden wood, visible hand-carved knife marks, sitting on a rustic wooden windowsill, soft daylight

name.zh: 孩子們手刻的椴木小動物擺件
name.zh_cn: 孩子们手刻的椴木小动物摆件

desc.zh: 工坊課上小傢伙們親手雕的小松鼠和小鹿，刀痕雖然稚拙，但都用砂紙反覆打磨平滑了，希望能為孩子們換一盒新蠟筆。
desc.zh_cn: 工坊课上小家伙们亲手雕的小松鼠和小鹿，刀痕虽然稚拙，但都用砂纸反复打磨平滑了，希望能为孩子们换一盒新蜡笔。
desc.en: Little squirrels and deer carved by the kids in handicraft class. The carving is clumsy, but nicely sanded smooth. Hoping to fund new crayons.

items.imgPrompt: folded patchwork knit wool blanket, pastel earth tones, cozy chunky texture, placed on an old worn wooden bench, warm morning sunlight

name.zh: 手工拼接純羊毛小膝毯
name.zh_cn: 手工拼接纯羊毛小膝毯

desc.zh: 用好心人捐贈的碎線團仔細清洗後織成的，配色有些混雜，但曬過太陽後非常蓬鬆暖和，孩子們長大了，希望能給怕冷的人添點溫暖。
desc.zh_cn: 用好心人捐赠的碎线团仔细清洗后织成的，配色有些混杂，但晒过太阳后非常蓬松暖和，孩子们长大了，希望能给怕冷的人添点温暖。
desc.en: Knitted from donated leftover yarn scraps, carefully washed and sun-dried. Warm and thick, hoping it keeps someone cold-sensitive warm.

items.imgPrompt: vintage clothbound herbology book, frayed cloth spine, yellowed deckled pages, pencil annotations, resting on a coarse linen tablecloth, soft natural shadows

name.zh: 泛黃的舊版《林間草藥與神話草本》
name.zh_cn: 泛黄的旧版《林间草药与神话草本》

desc.zh: 書脊邊角有些磨損，頁旁留有我用鉛筆寫的植物辨識小筆記。讀它時總能讓人心境沉靜，希望能遇見同樣珍愛它的朋友。
desc.zh_cn: 书脊边角有些磨损，页旁留有我用铅笔写的小植物辨识笔记。读它时总能让人心境沉静，希望能遇见同样珍爱它的朋友。
desc.en: Spine is slightly worn, with light pencil margins I made while studying herbs. It brings calm to the heart, hoping it finds a caring reader.

items.imgPrompt: vintage pale blue enamel kettle with hand-painted wildflower motifs, tiny chip on the spout rim, placed on a plain pine kitchen counter

name.zh: 淺藍小碎花復古搪瓷水壺
name.zh_cn: 浅蓝小碎花复古搪瓷水壶

desc.zh: 教會廚房勻給我們的小水壺，壺嘴邊緣有微小的掉瓷痕跡，但煮花草茶依然很好用，看著壺身的碎花圖案心情也會變好呢。
desc.zh_cn: 教会厨房匀给我们的小水壶，壶嘴边缘有微小的掉瓷痕迹，但煮花草茶依然很好用，看着壶身的碎花图案心情也会变好呢。
desc.en: A donated enamel kettle from the chapel kitchen. A tiny chip near the spout, but perfect for brewing herbal tea. Very cheerful floral pattern.

items.imgPrompt: natural unbleached linen cooking apron, embroidered with small white daisies on the bottom hem, neatly folded on a clean wooden table, gentle lighting

name.zh: 手縫雛菊刺繡原色亞麻圍裙
name.zh_cn: 手缝雏菊刺绣原色亚麻围裙

desc.zh: 自己空閒時裁布手縫的，裙擺繡了院子裡常開的雛菊。布料洗過兩次後很柔軟透氣，如果不介意手工針腳稍顯拙劣的話……
desc.zh_cn: 自己空闲时裁布手缝的，裙摆绣了院子里常开的雏菊。布料洗过两次后很柔软透气，如果不介意手工针脚稍显拙劣的话……
desc.en: Sewn by hand in my spare time, embroidered with garden daisies along the hem. Washed twice and soft, if you don't mind uneven hand stitches...

6b028cc2-e343-4219-b0f4-2561f9c4b2b2.line: 绕了三圈都没走出这条街，赶紧买点冰块啃啃冷静一下，顺便看一眼地图。

2fd090de-6441-4fd0-932c-f0cb0092dd8b.line: 今天训练强度有点大，必须猛猛吃顿肉补充体力，这家的肉排烤得还算凑合吧。

24f404b9-7efd-4512-b1c4-2bcf89d697aa.line: 今天又把头发烧焦了，买点便宜药膏糊弄一下，晚饭只能啃硬面包了唉。

0ddf4b64-629b-4cf4-81ae-2b8bd96deeb7.line: 新定的抗火风衣质感不错，顺手带了瓶香水，希望这次衣服能撑久一点。

f742ae18-c6a5-4fda-a84a-4411a2857438.line: 新买的素体骨架关节超灵活，今晚熬夜有得折腾了。

c1dedea8-4cad-4383-83a1-67d0be02f24a.line: 刨冰冻得我触角都立起来啦，不过软绵绵的口感真的太幸福了～

b707c49d-e68f-4e6a-aadd-e7a39394bfb0.line: 洗了一下午衣服手都起皮了，涂点手霜喝杯甜的感觉又活过来了。

d0929914-8722-40eb-b25e-73db42c2f711.line: 换了个透气的大陶盆，给带回来的幼苗安个家。

c649c020-6563-4eb3-8aa6-4d1c20682bc8.line: 吃饱了顺便把磨刀石换了，老的那块早开裂了。
